findings.problem: The hint excludes Stopp but not 'Stehen bleiben!', which is just as common as a police command, so a learner could fairly give that instead.
findings.fix: hint: one-word command shouted by police or guards, not Stopp

note: It might help to tell the learner that this Halt! is a different word from the particle halt on the word's other card and from the noun der Halt (support, hold).
